correctness.rationale: Unweighted wheel spectral decomposition is explicit. Scalar Padé multiplier is strictly positive, hence diagonals positive. Exact rational off-diagonal formulas for m=3..6 were verified with SymPy (12 symmetry classes plus full orbit checks). The Moore–Penrose rim-block formula was reconstructed from eigenprojectors and checked in ten finite sizes; the cyclic Green kernel and sharp lower bound prove uniformly that the adjacent-rim pseudoinverse is positive for every m≥6. Its -12/t leading term forces negative Padé entries at large time. The W6 numerator has exactly one positive root by Descartes rule and exact sign bracketing, while all other classes are strictly positive.

value.rationale: Unconditional entrywise positivity is a natural fidelity requirement for diffusion and Markov simulations. Wheels are the basic hub-augmented cycle family, and the theorem completely pinpoints when a hub-connected cycle remains safe at any step (through six total vertices) versus when the same discretization must eventually fail. The first failing wheel has a nontrivial exact algebraic sharp timestep, with a Green-kernel explanation in all larger sizes. This is a complete natural graph-family classification, not an arbitrary finite slice or a restatement of spectral tables.
